completion_definition: Completed means the initial curated cross-reference pass: the source verse and every listed target passage were read in the pinned Saints-Translation English records, and each retained pair has a specific explanation. It does not mean every possible biblical connection has been exhausted, or independent scholarly approval.
canon_policy: Old Testament cross-references exclusively within the Saints Holy Bible 70-book edition: 43 source books in their exact order and divisions; matching targets restricted to its 70 books.
chapter_status_scope: Each chapters entry is one original source section; completed_chapters aggregates all source sections carrying the same native chapter number.

original_book_metadata.source_status: Rahlfs–Hanhart 2006 remains the user-authorized provisional base. Focused checks of the publisher’s Greek running text are recorded by chapter. This is an English editorial revision, not a complete critical-text or apparatus verification. Göttingen, full apparatus, independent Greek and human read-aloud reviews remain pending.

verses.display_text: He moved among lions, became a lion, learned to seize prey, and ate human beings.

verses.text: He fed in his boldness, desolated their cities, and destroyed the land and its fullness by the sound of his roaring.
verses.display_text: He fed in his boldness, desolated their cities, and destroyed the land and its fullness by the sound of his roaring.

verses.text: Nations from the surrounding countries set themselves against him and spread their nets over him; he was caught in their destruction.
verses.display_text: Nations from the surrounding countries set themselves against him and spread their nets over him; he was caught in their destruction.

verses.text: They put him in a muzzle and a cage. He came to Babylon’s king, and he brought him into prison, so that his voice would not be heard upon Israel’s mountains.
verses.display_text: They put him in a muzzle and a cage. He came to Babylon’s king, and he brought him into prison, so that his voice would not be heard upon Israel’s mountains.

verses.text: Your mother was like a vine, like a blossom on a pomegranate tree, planted by water; her fruit and her shoot came from abundant water.
verses.display_text: Your mother was like a vine, like a blossom on a pomegranate tree, planted by water; her fruit and her shoot came from abundant water.

verses.text: She had a rod of strength for a tribe of leaders; it rose in her size among the trunks, and it saw her size among the multitude of her branches.
verses.display_text: She had a rod of strength for a tribe of leaders; it rose in her size among the trunks, and it saw her size among the multitude of her branches.

verses.text: She was broken off in wrath and thrown to the ground. The scorching wind dried her choice parts; her rod of strength was punished and dried up. Fire consumed her.
verses.display_text: She was broken off in wrath and thrown to the ground. The scorching wind dried her choice parts; her rod of strength was punished and dried up. Fire consumed her.

verses.text: Now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a waterless land,
verses.display_text: Now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a waterless land,

verses.text: and fire went out from a rod of her choice parts and devoured her, and there was no rod of strength in her. A tribe is for a parable of lament, and it will become a lament.”

verses.text: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, men from the elders of the house of Israel came to question the Lord and sat before me.

verses.text: “Son of man, speak to Israel’s elders and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Have you come to question Me? As I live, I will certainly not answer you, says the Lord.’
verses.display_text: “Son of man, speak to Israel’s elders and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Have you come to question Me? As I live, I will certainly not answer you, says the Lord.’

verses.text: Shall I indeed exact retribution upon them? Son of man, solemnly testify to them about their fathers’ lawlessness,
verses.display_text: Shall I indeed exact retribution upon them? Son of man, solemnly testify to them about their fathers’ lawlessness,

verses.text: and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: From the day I chose the house of Israel, I became known to the seed of Jacob’s house and was known to them in Egypt’s land. I supported them with My hand, saying, “I am the Lord your God.”

verses.text: On that day I supported them with My hand to bring them out of Egypt’s land into the land I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey; it is a honeycomb compared with all the earth.
verses.display_text: On that day I supported them with My hand to bring them out of Egypt’s land into the land I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey; it is a honeycomb compared with all the earth.

verses.text: I said to them, “Let each cast away the abominations of his eyes, and do not be defiled by Egypt’s practices. I am the Lord your God.”
verses.display_text: I said to them, “Let each cast away the abominations of his eyes, and do not be defiled by Egypt’s practices. I am the Lord your God.”

verses.text: They revolted from Me and would not listen to Me. They did not cast away the abominations of their eyes or abandon Egypt’s practices. I said I would pour My wrath upon them and complete My anger in them in the midst of Egypt’s land.
verses.display_text: They revolted from Me and would not listen to Me. They did not cast away the abominations of their eyes or abandon Egypt’s practices. I said I would pour My wrath upon them and complete My anger in them in the midst of Egypt’s land.

verses.text: I acted so that My name would not be profaned at all before the nations among whom they are, among whom I was known to them before their eyes by bringing them out of Egypt’s land.

verses.text: and gave them My commands and made My ordinances known to them, which a person will carry out and by which he will live.
verses.display_text: and gave them My commands and made My ordinances known to them, which a person will carry out and by which he will live.

verses.text: I gave them My sabbaths as a sign between Me and them, so that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.display_text: I gave them My sabbaths as a sign between Me and them, so that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.

I said I would pour My wrath upon them in the wilderness to consume them utterly.

verses.display_text: because they rejected My ordinances, did not walk in My commands, and were profaning My sabbaths, and they followed the reflections of their hearts.

verses.display_text: My eye spared them from obliteration, and I did not make a complete end of them in the wilderness.

verses.text: I said to their children in the wilderness, “Do not walk in your fathers’ ordinances, do not keep their judgments, do not mix yourselves with their practices, and do not be defiled.
verses.display_text: I said to their children in the wilderness, “Do not walk in your fathers’ ordinances, do not keep their judgments, do not mix yourselves with their practices, and do not be defiled.

verses.display_text: I am the Lord your God. Walk in My commands, keep My ordinances and carry them out,

I said I would pour My wrath upon them in the wilderness and complete My anger upon them.

verses.display_text: because they did not carry out My ordinances, rejected My commands and were profaning My sabbaths, while their eyes followed their fathers’ reflections.

verses.text: Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: To this extent your fathers angered Me in the transgressions they committed against Me.
verses.display_text: Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: To this extent your fathers angered Me in the transgressions they committed against Me.

verses.display_text: I brought them into the land I raised My hand to give them. They saw every high hill and every shady tree; there they sacrificed to their gods, there they set a fragrant aroma, and there they poured their libations.

verses.text: I said to them, “What is Abama, that you go in there?” They called its name Abama to this very day.’
verses.display_text: I said to them, “What is Abama, that you go in there?” They called its name Abama to this very day.’

verses.text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord: Are you being defiled in your fathers’ lawlessness and prostituting yourselves after their abominations?
verses.display_text: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord: Are you being defiled in your fathers’ lawlessness and prostituting yourselves after their abominations?

verses.text: In the firstfruits of your gifts, in your separations, you are being defiled with all your reflections to this very day. Shall I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord, I will certainly not answer you, nor will this rise upon your spirit.
verses.display_text: In the firstfruits of your gifts, in your separations, you are being defiled with all your reflections to this very day. Shall I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord, I will certainly not answer you, nor will this rise upon your spirit.

verses.text: It will not be as you say: “We will be like the nations and like the tribes of the earth, serving woods and stones.”
verses.display_text: It will not be as you say: “We will be like the nations and like the tribes of the earth, serving woods and stones.”

verses.text: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, with a mighty hand, a high arm and outpoured wrath I will reign over you.
verses.display_text: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, with a mighty hand, a high arm and outpoured wrath I will reign over you.

verses.text: I will bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries where you were scattered, with a mighty hand, a high arm and outpoured wrath.
verses.display_text: I will bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries where you were scattered, with a mighty hand, a high arm and outpoured wrath.

verses.text: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples and contend with you there, face to face.
verses.display_text: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples and contend with you there, face to face.

verses.text: As I contended with your fathers in the wilderness of Egypt’s land, so I will judge you, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: As I contended with your fathers in the wilderness of Egypt’s land, so I will judge you, says the Lord.

verses.text: I will lead you beneath My rod and bring you in by number,
verses.display_text: I will lead you beneath My rod and bring you in by number,

verses.text: and select from you the impious and those who have revolted, for I will bring them out of their sojourning, but they will not enter Israel’s land. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: and select from you the impious and those who have revolted, for I will bring them out of their sojourning, but they will not enter Israel’s land. You will recognize that I am the Lord.

verses.text: And you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Each of you, remove his practices! After these things, if you are not listening to Me, you will no longer profane My holy name with your gifts and practices.
verses.display_text: And you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Each of you, remove his practices! After these things, if you are not listening to Me, you will no longer profane My holy name with your gifts and practices.

verses.text: For upon My holy mountain, upon a high mountain, says the Lord, the Lord, there the whole house of Israel will serve Me to the end. There I will accept, and there I will attend to your firstfruits and the firstfruits of your separations, with all your holy things.
verses.display_text: For upon My holy mountain, upon a high mountain, says the Lord, the Lord, there the whole house of Israel will serve Me to the end. There I will accept, and there I will attend to your firstfruits and the firstfruits of your separations, with all your holy things.

verses.text: As a fragrant aroma I will accept you when I bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries where you were scattered. I will be sanctified among you before the eyes of the peoples.
verses.display_text: As a fragrant aroma I will accept you when I bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries where you were scattered. I will be sanctified among you before the eyes of the peoples.

verses.display_text: You will recognize that I am the Lord when I bring you into Israel’s land, into the land for which I raised My hand to give it to your fathers.

verses.text: There you will remember your ways and your practices by which you were being defiled; you will beat your faces over all your evils.
verses.display_text: There you will remember your ways and your practices by which you were being defiled; you will beat your faces over all your evils.

verses.text: You will recognize that I am the Lord when I deal thus with you so that My name may not be profaned according to your evil ways and corrupt practices, says the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: You will recognize that I am the Lord when I deal thus with you so that My name may not be profaned according to your evil ways and corrupt practices, says the Lord.’”

verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, set your face firmly toward Thaiman, look toward Darom, and prophesy against the leading forest, Nageb,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, set your face firmly toward Thaiman, look toward Darom, and prophesy against the leading forest, Nageb,

verses.text: and say to the Nageb forest, ‘Hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am kindling a fire within you. It will devour every green tree and every dry tree in you. The kindled flame will not be quenched, and every face from east to north will be burned by it.
verses.display_text: and say to the Nageb forest, ‘Hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am kindling a fire within you. It will devour every green tree and every dry tree in you. The kindled flame will not be quenched, and every face from east to north will be burned by it.

verses.display_text: All flesh will recognize that I, the Lord, have kindled it, and it will not be quenched.’”

verses.display_text: They reviled father and mother in you and dealt unjustly with the sojourner in you. They oppressed the orphan and widow in you.

verses.text: They despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths in you.
verses.display_text: They despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths in you.

verses.text: Robbers are in you in order to shed blood in you. They ate upon the mountains in you; they committed unholy acts within you.
verses.display_text: Robbers are in you in order to shed blood in you. They ate upon the mountains in you; they committed unholy acts within you.

verses.text: They uncovered a father’s shame in you, and they violated a woman sitting apart in uncleanness in you.
verses.display_text: They uncovered a father’s shame in you, and they violated a woman sitting apart in uncleanness in you.

verses.text: Each acted lawlessly with his neighbor’s wife; each defiled his daughter-in-law with impiety; each violated his sister, his father’s daughter, in you.
verses.display_text: Each acted lawlessly with his neighbor’s wife; each defiled his daughter-in-law with impiety; each violated his sister, his father’s daughter, in you.

verses.text: They took gifts in you in order to shed blood; they took interest and increase in you. You brought your evil in oppression to its full completion, but you forgot Me, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: They took gifts in you in order to shed blood; they took interest and increase in you. You brought your evil in oppression to its full completion, but you forgot Me, says the Lord.

verses.text: But if I strike My hand against My hand over what you have completed, what you did, and over your bloodshed that occurred within you,
verses.display_text: But if I strike My hand against My hand over what you have completed, what you did, and over your bloodshed that occurred within you,

verses.text: will your heart hold out? Will your hands prevail in the days when I act within you? I, the Lord, have spoken and will act.
verses.display_text: will your heart hold out? Will your hands prevail in the days when I act within you? I, the Lord, have spoken and will act.

verses.text: I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the countries, and your uncleanness will cease from you.
verses.display_text: I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the countries, and your uncleanness will cease from you.

verses.text: I will take possession in you before the nations’ eyes, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: I will take possession in you before the nations’ eyes, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, behold, Israel’s house has become mixed to Me, all of them with copper, iron, tin and lead; it is mixed amid silver.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, behold, Israel’s house has become mixed to Me, all of them with copper, iron, tin and lead; it is mixed amid silver.

verses.text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because all of you became one mixture, therefore I am receiving you into Jerusalem.
verses.display_text: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because all of you became one mixture, therefore I am receiving you into Jerusalem.

verses.text: As silver, copper, iron, tin and lead are received into a furnace to blow fire into it to melt it, so I will receive you in My anger, gather you and melt you,
verses.display_text: As silver, copper, iron, tin and lead are received into a furnace to blow fire into it to melt it, so I will receive you in My anger, gather you and melt you,

verses.text: and blow upon you with the fire of My anger, and you will be melted within her.
verses.display_text: and blow upon you with the fire of My anger, and you will be melted within her.

verses.text: As silver is melted within a furnace, so you will be melted within her. You will recognize that I, the Lord, have poured My wrath upon you.’”
verses.display_text: As silver is melted within a furnace, so you will be melted within her. You will recognize that I, the Lord, have poured My wrath upon you.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, say to her, ‘You are a land not wetted, nor did rain come upon you on the day of wrath.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, say to her, ‘You are a land not wetted, nor did rain come upon you on the day of wrath.

verses.text: Her leaders within her are like roaring lions seizing prey, devouring lives with power, taking payments unjustly, and your widows have multiplied within you.
verses.display_text: Her leaders within her are like roaring lions seizing prey, devouring lives with power, taking payments unjustly, and your widows have multiplied within you.

verses.text: Her priests set aside My law and profaned My holy things. They did not distinguish between holy and profane, nor distinguish between unclean and clean. They covered their eyes from My Sabbaths, and I was profaned among them.
verses.display_text: Her priests set aside My law and profaned My holy things. They did not distinguish between holy and profane, nor distinguish between unclean and clean. They covered their eyes from My Sabbaths, and I was profaned among them.

verses.text: Her rulers within her are like wolves seizing prey to shed blood, so that in greed they may gain more.
verses.display_text: Her rulers within her are like wolves seizing prey to shed blood, so that in greed they may gain more.

verses.text: Her prophets, coating them, will fall, seeing vain things, divining falsehoods, saying, “Thus says the Lord,” when the Lord has not spoken,
verses.display_text: Her prophets, coating them, will fall, seeing vain things, divining falsehoods, saying, “Thus says the Lord,” when the Lord has not spoken,

verses.text: oppressing the people of the land unjustly and seizing plunder, oppressing the poor and needy and not dealing justly with the sojourner.
verses.display_text: oppressing the people of the land unjustly and seizing plunder, oppressing the poor and needy and not dealing justly with the sojourner.

verses.text: I sought among them a man conducting himself rightly and standing wholly before Me at the land’s time, so that I would not utterly wipe her out, but I found none.
verses.display_text: I sought among them a man conducting himself rightly and standing wholly before Me at the land’s time, so that I would not utterly wipe her out, but I found none.

verses.text: I poured My wrath upon her in the fire of My anger to bring an end. I brought their ways upon their own heads, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: I poured My wrath upon her in the fire of My anger to bring an end. I brought their ways upon their own heads, says the Lord, the Lord.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother,

verses.text: and they prostituted themselves in Egypt in their youth. There their breasts fell; there they were deflowered.
verses.display_text: and they prostituted themselves in Egypt in their youth. There their breasts fell; there they were deflowered.

verses.text: Their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister. They became Mine and bore sons and daughters. Their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
verses.display_text: Their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister. They became Mine and bore sons and daughters. Their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.

verses.text: Oholah prostituted herself away from Me and set her desire upon her lovers, the Assyrians approaching her,
verses.display_text: Oholah prostituted herself away from Me and set her desire upon her lovers, the Assyrians approaching her,

verses.text: clothed in blue-purple, leaders and generals; all choice young men, horsemen riding horses.
verses.display_text: clothed in blue-purple, leaders and generals; all choice young men, horsemen riding horses.

verses.text: She bestowed her prostitution upon them, all choice sons of Assyrians; and with all upon whom she set her desire, in all her reflections she was defiled.
verses.display_text: She bestowed her prostitution upon them, all choice sons of Assyrians; and with all upon whom she set her desire, in all her reflections she was defiled.

verses.text: She did not abandon her prostitution from Egypt, for they lay with her in her youth; they deflowered her and poured their prostitution upon her.
verses.display_text: She did not abandon her prostitution from Egypt, for they lay with her in her youth; they deflowered her and poured their prostitution upon her.

verses.text: Therefore I handed her into her lovers’ hands, into the hands of Assyrians’ sons, upon whom she had set her desire.
verses.display_text: Therefore I handed her into her lovers’ hands, into the hands of Assyrians’ sons, upon whom she had set her desire.

verses.text: They uncovered her shame, took her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. She became a subject of talk among women, and they inflicted punishments upon her, upon the daughters.
verses.display_text: They uncovered her shame, took her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. She became a subject of talk among women, and they inflicted punishments upon her, upon the daughters.

verses.text: Her sister Oholibah saw this and corrupted her desire beyond hers, and her prostitution beyond her sister’s prostitution.
verses.display_text: Her sister Oholibah saw this and corrupted her desire beyond hers, and her prostitution beyond her sister’s prostitution.

verses.text: She set her desire upon Assyrians’ sons, leaders and generals near her, clothed in finely bordered garments, horsemen riding horses; all choice young men.
verses.display_text: She set her desire upon Assyrians’ sons, leaders and generals near her, clothed in finely bordered garments, horsemen riding horses; all choice young men.

verses.text: I saw that she was defiled; one way for the two.
verses.display_text: I saw that she was defiled; one way for the two.

verses.text: She added to her prostitution and saw men depicted upon the wall, images of Chaldeans drawn with a stylus,
verses.display_text: She added to her prostitution and saw men depicted upon the wall, images of Chaldeans drawn with a stylus,

verses.text: girded with embroidered work at their waists, with dyed tiaras upon their heads, all with a threefold appearance, the likeness of Chaldeans’ sons from their native land.
verses.display_text: girded with embroidered work at their waists, with dyed tiaras upon their heads, all with a threefold appearance, the likeness of Chaldeans’ sons from their native land.

verses.text: She set her desire upon them at the sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them in the Chaldeans’ land.
verses.display_text: She set her desire upon them at the sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them in the Chaldeans’ land.

verses.text: Babylon’s sons came to her, to a bed of lodgers, and defiled her in her prostitution. She was defiled by them, and her soul withdrew from them.
verses.display_text: Babylon’s sons came to her, to a bed of lodgers, and defiled her in her prostitution. She was defiled by them, and her soul withdrew from them.

verses.text: She uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her shame. My soul withdrew from her, as My soul had withdrawn from her sister.
verses.display_text: She uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her shame. My soul withdrew from her, as My soul had withdrawn from her sister.

verses.text: You multiplied your prostitution to recall the days of your youth, in which you prostituted yourself in Egypt,
verses.display_text: You multiplied your prostitution to recall the days of your youth, in which you prostituted yourself in Egypt,

verses.text: and you set your desire upon the Chaldeans, whose flesh was like donkeys’ and whose genitals were horses’ genitals.
verses.display_text: and you set your desire upon the Chaldeans, whose flesh was like donkeys’ and whose genitals were horses’ genitals.

verses.text: You revisited the lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt at your lodging, where your youthful breasts were.
verses.display_text: You revisited the lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt at your lodging, where your youthful breasts were.

verses.text: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord: Behold, I am rousing your lovers against you, those from whom your soul withdrew. I will bring them against you all around:
verses.display_text: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord: Behold, I am rousing your lovers against you, those from whom your soul withdrew. I will bring them against you all around:

verses.text: Babylon’s sons and all the Chaldeans, Phakoud, Soue and Koue, and all Assyrians’ sons with them, choice young men, all leaders and generals, threefold men and renowned men riding horses.
verses.display_text: Babylon’s sons and all the Chaldeans, Phakoud, Soue and Koue, and all Assyrians’ sons with them, choice young men, all leaders and generals, threefold men and renowned men riding horses.

verses.text: All will come against you from the north: chariots and wheels with a multitude of peoples, large shields and small shields; they will set a guard against you all around. I will set judgment before them, and they will punish you by their judgments.
verses.display_text: All will come against you from the north: chariots and wheels with a multitude of peoples, large shields and small shields; they will set a guard against you all around. I will set judgment before them, and they will punish you by their judgments.

verses.text: I will set My jealousy within you, and they will deal with you in fierce anger. They will remove your nose and ears and strike down your remaining people with the sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and fire will consume your remaining people.
verses.display_text: I will set My jealousy within you, and they will deal with you in fierce anger. They will remove your nose and ears and strike down your remaining people with the sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and fire will consume your remaining people.

verses.text: They will strip you of your clothing and take the objects of your boasting.
verses.display_text: They will strip you of your clothing and take the objects of your boasting.

verses.text: I will turn your impieties away from you and your prostitution from Egypt’s land. You certainly will not lift your eyes toward them, and you certainly will no longer remember Egypt.
verses.display_text: I will turn your impieties away from you and your prostitution from Egypt’s land. You certainly will not lift your eyes toward them, and you certainly will no longer remember Egypt.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am handing you into the hands of those you hate, those from whom your soul withdrew.
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am handing you into the hands of those you hate, those from whom your soul withdrew.

verses.text: They will deal with you in hatred and take all the fruit of your pain and toil. You will be naked and exposed to shame, and the shame of your prostitution and your impiety will be uncovered. Your prostitution
verses.display_text: They will deal with you in hatred and take all the fruit of your pain and toil. You will be naked and exposed to shame, and the shame of your prostitution and your impiety will be uncovered. Your prostitution

verses.text: did these things to you when you prostituted yourself after nations and were defiled in their reflections.
verses.display_text: did these things to you when you prostituted yourself after nations and were defiled in their reflections.

verses.text: You walked in your sister’s way; I will put her cup into your hands.
verses.display_text: You walked in your sister’s way; I will put her cup into your hands.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: You will drink your sister’s cup, deep and wide, abounding to bring about
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: You will drink your sister’s cup, deep and wide, abounding to bring about

verses.text: drunkenness; you will be filled with collapse. And the cup of annihilation, your sister Samaria’s cup—
verses.display_text: drunkenness; you will be filled with collapse. And the cup of annihilation, your sister Samaria’s cup—

verses.text: you will drink it. I will turn away her festivals and her new moons, for I have spoken, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: you will drink it. I will turn away her festivals and her new moons, for I have spoken, says the Lord.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you forgot Me and cast Me behind your body, you too must take your impiety and your prostitution.”
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you forgot Me and cast Me behind your body, you too must take your impiety and your prostitution.”

verses.text: The Lord said to me, “Son of man, will you not judge Oholah and Oholibah? Declare their lawless deeds to them,
verses.display_text: The Lord said to me, “Son of man, will you not judge Oholah and Oholibah? Declare their lawless deeds to them,

verses.text: for they committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their reflections, and made their children whom they bore to Me pass through fire offerings for them.
verses.display_text: for they committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their reflections, and made their children whom they bore to Me pass through fire offerings for them.

verses.text: They even did these things to Me: they defiled My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.
verses.display_text: They even did these things to Me: they defiled My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.

verses.text: When they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My holy places to profane them. Indeed, they acted this way within My house.
verses.display_text: When they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My holy places to profane them. Indeed, they acted this way within My house.

verses.text: Indeed, for the men coming from far away, to whom they sent messengers—as soon as they arrived, you immediately bathed, painted your eyes with antimony and adorned yourself with ornaments,
verses.display_text: Indeed, for the men coming from far away, to whom they sent messengers—as soon as they arrived, you immediately bathed, painted your eyes with antimony and adorned yourself with ornaments,

verses.text: and sat upon a spread couch with an adorned table before it. My incense and My oil—they delighted in them.
verses.display_text: and sat upon a spread couch with an adorned table before it. My incense and My oil—they delighted in them.

verses.text: They struck up a harmonious sound. With men arriving from the mass of people out of the wilderness, they gave bracelets for their hands and a crown of boasting upon their heads.
verses.display_text: They struck up a harmonious sound. With men arriving from the mass of people out of the wilderness, they gave bracelets for their hands and a crown of boasting upon their heads.

verses.text: I said, ‘Do they not commit adultery in these things? A prostitute’s deeds—and she herself prostituted herself!’
verses.display_text: I said, ‘Do they not commit adultery in these things? A prostitute’s deeds—and she herself prostituted herself!’

verses.text: They entered her as they enter a prostitute; so they entered Oholah and Oholibah to commit lawlessness.
verses.display_text: They entered her as they enter a prostitute; so they entered Oholah and Oholibah to commit lawlessness.

verses.text: Righteous men will punish them with the punishment of an adulteress and the punishment of bloodshed, for they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.
verses.display_text: Righteous men will punish them with the punishment of an adulteress and the punishment of bloodshed, for they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Bring a multitude against them and set turmoil and plunder among them,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Bring a multitude against them and set turmoil and plunder among them,

verses.text: and stone them with the multitude’s stones and pierce them with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn their houses.
verses.display_text: and stone them with the multitude’s stones and pierce them with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn their houses.

verses.text: I will turn impiety away from the land. All women will be disciplined and certainly will not act according to their impieties.
verses.display_text: I will turn impiety away from the land. All women will be disciplined and certainly will not act according to their impieties.

verses.text: Your impiety will be brought upon you, and you will receive the sins of your reflections. You will know that I am the Lord.”
verses.display_text: Your impiety will be brought upon you, and you will receive the sins of your reflections. You will know that I am the Lord.”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, write for yourself a record of the day, from this day on which Babylon’s king pressed against Jerusalem, from this present day,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, write for yourself a record of the day, from this day on which Babylon’s king pressed against Jerusalem, from this present day,

verses.text: and speak a parable against the provoking house. Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Set on the cauldron and pour water into it,
verses.display_text: and speak a parable against the provoking house. Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Set on the cauldron and pour water into it,

verses.text: and put the cut pieces into it, every good cut, leg and shoulder stripped from the bones,
verses.display_text: and put the cut pieces into it, every good cut, leg and shoulder stripped from the bones,

verses.text: from choice animals taken. Burn the bones beneath them. It boiled, it boiled, and her bones have been cooked within her.
verses.display_text: from choice animals taken. Burn the bones beneath them. It boiled, it boiled, and her bones have been cooked within her.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of bloodshed! A cauldron with rust in it, whose rust has not come out of her! He brought it out limb by limb; no lot fell upon her.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of bloodshed! A cauldron with rust in it, whose rust has not come out of her! He brought it out limb by limb; no lot fell upon her.

verses.text: For her blood is within her. I have set it upon smooth rock; I have not poured it upon the earth to cover it with earth.
verses.display_text: For her blood is within her. I have set it upon smooth rock; I have not poured it upon the earth to cover it with earth.

verses.text: To make wrath rise for vengeance to be exacted, I have set her blood upon smooth rock so that it will not be covered.
verses.display_text: To make wrath rise for vengeance to be exacted, I have set her blood upon smooth rock so that it will not be covered.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: I too will enlarge the firebrand
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: I too will enlarge the firebrand

verses.text: and multiply the wood and kindle the fire, so that the flesh melts and the broth is reduced,
verses.display_text: and multiply the wood and kindle the fire, so that the flesh melts and the broth is reduced,

verses.text: and it stands upon the coals, so that its copper is scorched and heated and melts amid its uncleanness, and its rust ceases,
verses.display_text: and it stands upon the coals, so that its copper is scorched and heated and melts amid its uncleanness, and its rust ceases,

verses.text: yet her abundant rust certainly will not leave her; her rust will be put to shame,
verses.display_text: yet her abundant rust certainly will not leave her; her rust will be put to shame,

verses.text: because you were being defiled. And what if you are not cleansed any more until I fill up My wrath?
verses.display_text: because you were being defiled. And what if you are not cleansed any more until I fill up My wrath?

verses.text: I, the Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will act. I will not draw back, nor will I show mercy. According to your ways and your reflections I will judge you, says the Lord. Therefore I will judge you according to your bloodshed, and according to your reflections I will judge you, the unclean one, the famous one, abundant in provoking.’”
verses.display_text: I, the Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will act. I will not draw back, nor will I show mercy. Therefore I will judge you according to your bloodshed, and according to your reflections I will judge you, the unclean one, the famous one, abundant in provoking.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, behold, I am taking the desires of your eyes from you in battle array. You certainly will not beat your breast, nor be wept over.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, behold, I am taking the desires of your eyes from you in battle array. You certainly will not beat your breast, nor be wept over.

verses.text: It is a groaning of blood, of loins, of mourning. Your hair will not be plaited upon you, nor will your footwear be on your feet. You certainly will not be comforted by their lips or eat the bread of men.
verses.display_text: It is a groaning of blood, of loins, of mourning. Your hair will not be plaited upon you, nor will your footwear be on your feet. You certainly will not be comforted by their lips or eat the bread of men.

verses.text: I spoke to the people in the morning as He commanded me, and my wife died in the evening. In the morning I did as I was ordered.
verses.display_text: I spoke to the people in the morning as He commanded me, and my wife died in the evening. In the morning I did as I was ordered.

verses.text: The people said to me, “Will you not tell us what these things are that you are doing?”
verses.display_text: The people said to me, “Will you not tell us what these things are that you are doing?”

verses.text: I said to them, “The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: I said to them, “The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: ‘Say to Israel’s house, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am profaning My holy things, the boast of your strength, the desires of your eyes, those for whom your souls care. Your sons and daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.
verses.display_text: ‘Say to Israel’s house, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am profaning My holy things, the boast of your strength, the desires of your eyes, those for whom your souls care. Your sons and daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.

verses.text: You will do as I have done: you will not be comforted from their mouth or eat the bread of men,
verses.display_text: You will do as I have done: you will not be comforted from their mouth or eat the bread of men,

verses.text: with your hair upon your heads and your footwear on your feet. You certainly will neither beat your breasts nor weep; you will waste away in your injustices and each will comfort his brother.
verses.display_text: with your hair upon your heads and your footwear on your feet. You certainly will neither beat your breasts nor weep; you will waste away in your injustices and each will comfort his brother.

verses.text: Ezekiel will be a portent for you; according to everything he has done, you will do when these things come. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: Ezekiel will be a portent for you; according to everything he has done, you will do when these things come. You will recognize that I am the Lord.

verses.text: And you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take their strength from them, the exaltation of their boasting, the desires of their eyes, the exaltation of their soul, their sons and daughters—
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take their strength from them, the exaltation of their boasting, the desires of their eyes, the exaltation of their soul, their sons and daughters—

verses.text: on that day the survivor will come to you to announce it into your ears?
verses.display_text: on that day the survivor will come to you to announce it into your ears?

verses.text: On that day your mouth will be opened toward the survivor; you will speak and certainly will no longer be struck mute. You will be a portent for them, and they will recognize that I am the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: On that day your mouth will be opened toward the survivor; you will speak and certainly will no longer be struck mute. You will be a portent for them, and they will recognize that I am the Lord.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, set your face firmly against the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, set your face firmly against the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,

verses.text: and say to Ammon’s sons, ‘Hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord: Because you rejoiced over My holy things when they were profaned, over Israel’s land when it was devastated, and over Judah’s house when they went into captivity,
verses.display_text: and say to Ammon’s sons, ‘Hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord: Because you rejoiced over My holy things when they were profaned, over Israel’s land when it was devastated, and over Judah’s house when they went into captivity,

verses.display_text: therefore behold, I am handing you to the sons of Kedem as an inheritance. They will camp with their equipment in you and set their dwellings in you. They will eat your fruits and drink your richness.

verses.display_text: I will make Ammon’s city pastures for camels, and Ammon’s sons a pasture for sheep. You will recognize that I am the Lord.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord: Because you clapped your hand and made noise with your foot, and rejoiced from your soul over Israel’s land,
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord: Because you clapped your hand and made noise with your foot, and rejoiced from your soul over Israel’s land,

verses.text: therefore I will stretch My hand against you, give you to plunder among the nations, utterly destroy you from the peoples and make you perish from the countries with destruction. You will recognize that I am the Lord.’
verses.display_text: therefore I will stretch My hand against you, give you to plunder among the nations, utterly destroy you from the peoples and make you perish from the countries with destruction. You will recognize that I am the Lord.’

verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Because Moab said, ‘Behold, Israel’s and Judah’s house is like all the nations,’

verses.display_text: therefore behold, I am paralyzing Moab’s shoulder from its frontier cities, the choice land, the house of Asimouth above a spring of a coastal city.

verses.text: To Kedem’s sons, against Ammon’s sons, I have given them as an inheritance, so that no remembrance of Ammon’s sons may remain.
verses.display_text: To Kedem’s sons, against Ammon’s sons, I have given them as an inheritance, so that no remembrance of Ammon’s sons may remain.

verses.text: I will exact vengeance upon Moab, and they will recognize that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will exact vengeance upon Moab, and they will recognize that I am the Lord.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: Because Idumea acted in vengeance against Judah’s house, and they bore a grudge and exacted punishment,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: Because Idumea acted in vengeance against Judah’s house, and they bore a grudge and exacted punishment,

verses.text: therefore thus says the Lord: I will stretch My hand against Idumea and utterly destroy human and animal from her. I will make her a wilderness, and those pursued from Thaiman will fall by the sword.
verses.display_text: therefore thus says the Lord: I will stretch My hand against Idumea and utterly destroy human and animal from her. I will make her a wilderness, and those pursued from Thaiman will fall by the sword.

verses.text: I will place My vengeance upon Idumea by the hand of My people Israel. They will act in Idumea according to My anger and My wrath, and they will recognize My vengeance, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will place My vengeance upon Idumea by the hand of My people Israel. They will act in Idumea according to My anger and My wrath, and they will recognize My vengeance, says the Lord.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because the foreigners acted in vengeance and stirred up vengeance, rejoicing from their soul to wipe out for ever,
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because the foreigners acted in vengeance and stirred up vengeance, rejoicing from their soul to wipe out for ever,

verses.text: therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I will stretch My hand against the foreigners, utterly destroy Cretans and make the remaining inhabitants of the coast perish.

verses.display_text: I will execute great acts of vengeance upon them. They will recognize that I am the Lord when I bring My vengeance upon them.”

verses.text: In the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: In the eleventh year, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, because Tyre said of Jerusalem, ‘Well done! She is shattered; the nations have perished. She has turned to me; the full one has been laid waste,’
verses.display_text: “Son of man, because Tyre said of Jerusalem, ‘Well done! She is shattered; the nations have perished. She has turned to me; the full one has been laid waste,’

verses.text: therefore thus says the Lord: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea rises with its waves.
verses.display_text: therefore thus says the Lord: I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring many nations against you, as the sea rises with its waves.

verses.text: They will throw down Tyre’s walls and throw down your towers. I will winnow her dust from her and make her a smooth rock.
verses.display_text: They will throw down Tyre’s walls and throw down your towers. I will winnow her dust from her and make her a smooth rock.

verses.text: She will be a drying place for nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord. She will become plunder for the nations,
verses.display_text: She will be a drying place for nets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord. She will become plunder for the nations,

verses.text: and her daughters in the plain will be killed by the sword. They will know that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: and her daughters in the plain will be killed by the sword. They will know that I am the Lord.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord: I am bringing against you, Tyre, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north—he is king of kings—with horses, chariots, horsemen, and an assembly of very many nations.
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord: I am bringing against you, Tyre, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north—he is king of kings—with horses, chariots, horsemen, and an assembly of very many nations.

verses.text: He will kill your daughters in the plain with the sword, set an advance guard against you, build around you, and make a palisade and a ring of weapons around you; he will set his spears opposite you.
verses.display_text: He will kill your daughters in the plain with the sword, set an advance guard against you, build around you, and make a palisade and a ring of weapons around you; he will set his spears opposite you.

verses.text: He will throw down your walls and your towers with his swords.
verses.display_text: He will throw down your walls and your towers with his swords.

verses.text: The dust of his multitude of horses will cover you, and your walls will shake at the sound of his horsemen and his chariots’ wheels when he enters your gates like someone entering a city from the plain.
verses.display_text: The dust of his multitude of horses will cover you, and your walls will shake at the sound of his horsemen and his chariots’ wheels when he enters your gates like someone entering a city from the plain.

verses.text: With his horses’ hoofs they will trample all your squares. He will kill your people with the sword and bring the support of your strength down to the ground.
verses.display_text: With his horses’ hoofs they will trample all your squares. He will kill your people with the sword and bring the support of your strength down to the ground.

verses.text: He will plunder your strength, strip your possessions, throw down your walls, and demolish your desirable houses. He will throw your stones, timber, and dust into the sea.
verses.display_text: He will plunder your strength, strip your possessions, throw down your walls, and demolish your desirable houses. He will throw your stones, timber, and dust into the sea.

verses.text: He will put an end to the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your psalteries will certainly no longer be heard.
verses.display_text: He will put an end to the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your psalteries will certainly no longer be heard.

verses.text: I will make you a smooth rock, a drying place for nets. You will certainly not be rebuilt, for I have spoken, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will make you a smooth rock, a drying place for nets. You will certainly not be rebuilt, for I have spoken, says the Lord.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord, the Lord, to Tyre: Will not the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and a sword is drawn within you?
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord, the Lord, to Tyre: Will not the islands shake at the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan and a sword is drawn within you?

verses.text: All the rulers from the nations of the sea will step down from their thrones, remove the turbans from their heads, and strip off their patterned clothing. They will be utterly astonished, sit on the ground, fear their own destruction, and groan over you.
verses.display_text: All the rulers from the nations of the sea will step down from their thrones, remove the turbans from their heads, and strip off their patterned clothing. They will be utterly astonished, sit on the ground, fear their own destruction, and groan over you.

verses.text: They will raise a lament over you and say to you: ‘How you were destroyed from the sea, praised city that spread her fear to all who live in her!
verses.display_text: They will raise a lament over you and say to you: ‘How you were destroyed from the sea, praised city that spread her fear to all who live in her!

verses.text: The islands will be afraid from the day of your fall.’
verses.display_text: The islands will be afraid from the day of your fall.’

verses.text: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: When I make you a desolated city like cities that will not be inhabited, when I bring the abyss up over you and much water covers you,
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: When I make you a desolated city like cities that will not be inhabited, when I bring the abyss up over you and much water covers you,

verses.text: I will bring you down to those descending into the pit, to the people of old. I will settle you in the depths of the earth like an everlasting wilderness, with those descending into the pit, so that you are not inhabited and do not rise in the land of life.
verses.display_text: I will bring you down to those descending into the pit, to the people of old. I will settle you in the depths of the earth like an everlasting wilderness, with those descending into the pit, so that you are not inhabited and do not rise in the land of life.

verses.text: I will bring you to ruin, and you will no longer exist for ever, says the Lord, the Lord.”
verses.display_text: I will bring you to ruin, and you will no longer exist for ever, says the Lord, the Lord.”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, take up a lament over Tyre,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, take up a lament over Tyre,

verses.text: and say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrance of the sea, the trading place of the peoples from many islands: Thus says the Lord to Tyre: You said, ‘I have clothed myself with my beauty.’
verses.display_text: and say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrance of the sea, the trading place of the peoples from many islands: Thus says the Lord to Tyre: You said, ‘I have clothed myself with my beauty.’

verses.text: In the heart of the sea, at Beelim, your sons clothed you with beauty.
verses.display_text: In the heart of the sea, at Beelim, your sons clothed you with beauty.

verses.text: Cedar from Senir was built for you; strips of cypress planks were taken from Lebanon to make fir masts for you.
verses.display_text: Cedar from Senir was built for you; strips of cypress planks were taken from Lebanon to make fir masts for you.

verses.text: From Bashan they made your oars; they made your sacred places from ivory, wooded houses from the islands of Kittim.
verses.display_text: From Bashan they made your oars; they made your sacred places from ivory, wooded houses from the islands of Kittim.

verses.text: Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt became your bedding, to clothe you with glory and wrap you in blue and purple from the islands of Elishah; it became your coverings.
verses.display_text: Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt became your bedding, to clothe you with glory and wrap you in blue and purple from the islands of Elishah; it became your coverings.

verses.text: Your rulers who inhabit Sidon, and the Arvadites, became your rowers; your wise men, Tyre, who were in you, were your pilots.
verses.display_text: Your rulers who inhabit Sidon, and the Arvadites, became your rowers; your wise men, Tyre, who were in you, were your pilots.

verses.text: The elders of Byblos and their wise men were in you; they strengthened your counsel. All the ships of the sea and their rowers came to you toward the farthest west.
verses.display_text: The elders of Byblos and their wise men were in you; they strengthened your counsel. All the ships of the sea and their rowers came to you toward the farthest west.

verses.text: Persians, Lydians, and Libyans were in your force; your warrior men hung small shields and helmets in you; they gave you your glory.
verses.display_text: Persians, Lydians, and Libyans were in your force; your warrior men hung small shields and helmets in you; they gave you your glory.

verses.text: Sons of Arvadites and your force were on your walls; guards were in your towers. They hung their quivers around your harbors; they completed your beauty.
verses.display_text: Sons of Arvadites and your force were on your walls; guards were in your towers. They hung their quivers around your harbors; they completed your beauty.

verses.text: Carthaginians were your traders because of the abundance of all your strength; they gave silver, gold, iron, tin, and lead for your market.
verses.display_text: Carthaginians were your traders because of the abundance of all your strength; they gave silver, gold, iron, tin, and lead for your market.

verses.text: Greece, all of it, and the adjoining regions traded with you in human lives, and gave bronze vessels for your commerce.
verses.display_text: Greece, all of it, and the adjoining regions traded with you in human lives, and gave bronze vessels for your commerce.

verses.text: From the house of Togarmah they gave horses and horsemen for your market.
verses.display_text: From the house of Togarmah they gave horses and horsemen for your market.

verses.text: Sons of Rhodians were your traders; from islands they increased your commerce with ivory tusks, and you gave your payments in exchange for the imported goods,
verses.display_text: Sons of Rhodians were your traders; from islands they increased your commerce with ivory tusks, and you gave your payments in exchange for the imported goods,

verses.text: people as your merchandise from the abundance of your mixed company, myrrh drops and embroideries from Tarshish; Ramoth and Chorchor gave for your market.
verses.display_text: people as your merchandise from the abundance of your mixed company, myrrh drops and embroideries from Tarshish; Ramoth and Chorchor gave for your market.

verses.text: Judah and the sons of Israel were your traders in the sale of grain, perfumes, and cassia; they gave choice honey, oil, and resin to your mixed company.
verses.display_text: Judah and the sons of Israel were your traders in the sale of grain, perfumes, and cassia; they gave choice honey, oil, and resin to your mixed company.

verses.text: Damascus was your trader because of the abundance of all your strength: wine from Helbon and wool from Miletus;
verses.display_text: Damascus was your trader because of the abundance of all your strength: wine from Helbon and wool from Miletus;

verses.text: and they gave wine for your market. From Asel, worked iron and a wheel are among your mixed company.
verses.display_text: and they gave wine for your market. From Asel, worked iron and a wheel are among your mixed company.

verses.text: Dedan was your trader with choice animals for chariots.
verses.display_text: Dedan was your trader with choice animals for chariots.

verses.text: Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar were your traders through your hand, with camels, rams, and lambs in which they traded with you.
verses.display_text: Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar were your traders through your hand, with camels, rams, and lambs in which they traded with you.

verses.text: Traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders with choice spices and good stones, and they gave gold for your market.
verses.display_text: Traders of Sheba and Raamah were your traders with choice spices and good stones, and they gave gold for your market.

verses.text: Haran and Channa were your traders; Asshur and Charman were your traders,
verses.display_text: Haran and Channa were your traders; Asshur and Charman were your traders,

verses.text: bringing merchandise, blue cloth and choice treasures bound with cords, and cypress
verses.display_text: bringing merchandise, blue cloth and choice treasures bound with cords, and cypress

verses.text: ships: in them Carthaginians were your traders in abundance among your mixed company. You were filled and became very heavy in the heart of the sea.
verses.display_text: ships: in them Carthaginians were your traders in abundance among your mixed company. You were filled and became very heavy in the heart of the sea.

verses.text: Your rowers led you in much water; the south wind shattered you in the heart of the sea.
verses.display_text: Your rowers led you in much water; the south wind shattered you in the heart of the sea.

verses.text: There were your forces, your payment and that of your mixed companies, your rowers and pilots, your counselors and your mixed companies from your mixed companies, all your warrior men in you, and your whole assembly within you; they will fall in the heart of the sea on the day of your fall.
verses.display_text: There were your forces, your payment and that of your mixed companies, your rowers and pilots, your counselors and your mixed companies from your mixed companies, all your warrior men in you, and your whole assembly within you; they will fall in the heart of the sea on the day of your fall.

verses.text: At the sound of your cry, your pilots will be greatly afraid,
verses.display_text: At the sound of your cry, your pilots will be greatly afraid,

verses.text: and all your rowers will come down from the ships; the passengers and the lookouts of the sea will stand on the land.
verses.display_text: and all your rowers will come down from the ships; the passengers and the lookouts of the sea will stand on the land.

verses.text: They will raise a cry over you with their voice and cry bitterly; they will put earth on their head and spread ashes beneath them.
verses.display_text: They will raise a cry over you with their voice and cry bitterly; they will put earth on their head and spread ashes beneath them.

verses.text: Their sons will take up a lament over you and a lamentation for you:
verses.display_text: Their sons will take up a lament over you and a lamentation for you:

verses.text: ‘What a payment you found from the sea! You filled nations from your abundance, and from your mixed company you enriched all the kings of the earth.
verses.display_text: ‘What a payment you found from the sea! You filled nations from your abundance, and from your mixed company you enriched all the kings of the earth.

verses.text: Now you were shattered in the sea, in the depth of water; your mixed company and all your assembly fell within you—all your rowers.
verses.display_text: Now you were shattered in the sea, in the depth of water; your mixed company and all your assembly fell within you—all your rowers.

verses.text: All who inhabit the islands became gloomy over you; their kings were utterly astonished, and their faces shed tears.
verses.display_text: All who inhabit the islands became gloomy over you; their kings were utterly astonished, and their faces shed tears.

verses.text: Traders from nations hissed at you; you came to ruin, and you will be no more for ever.’”
verses.display_text: Traders from nations hissed at you; you came to ruin, and you will be no more for ever.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “And you, son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre: Thus says the Lord: Because your heart was exalted and you said, ‘I am a god; I have inhabited a god’s dwelling in the heart of the sea’—yet you are a human, and not a god, and you made your heart like a god’s heart—
verses.display_text: “And you, son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre: Thus says the Lord: Because your heart was exalted and you said, ‘I am a god; I have inhabited a god’s dwelling in the heart of the sea’—yet you are a human, and not a god, and you made your heart like a god’s heart—

verses.text: Surely you are not wiser than Daniel? Did wise men not instruct you in their knowledge?
verses.display_text: Surely you are not wiser than Daniel? Did wise men not instruct you in their knowledge?

verses.text: Surely it was not by your knowledge or understanding that you built up strength for yourself, and gold and silver in your treasuries?
verses.display_text: Surely it was not by your knowledge or understanding that you built up strength for yourself, and gold and silver in your treasuries?

verses.text: By your abundant knowledge and your trade you increased your strength; your heart was exalted in your strength.
verses.display_text: By your abundant knowledge and your trade you increased your strength; your heart was exalted in your strength.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Since you made your heart like a god’s heart,
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Since you made your heart like a god’s heart,

verses.text: therefore, behold, I am bringing foreigners against you, scourges from nations. They will draw their swords against you and against the beauty of your knowledge, and lay your beauty out for destruction,
verses.display_text: therefore, behold, I am bringing foreigners against you, scourges from nations. They will draw their swords against you and against the beauty of your knowledge, and lay your beauty out for destruction,

verses.text: and they will bring you down; you will die the death of wounded men in the heart of the sea.
verses.display_text: and they will bring you down; you will die the death of wounded men in the heart of the sea.

verses.text: Surely you will not say, ‘I am a god,’ before those killing you? You are a human, and not a god. In a multitude
verses.display_text: Surely you will not say, ‘I am a god,’ before those killing you? You are a human, and not a god. In a multitude

verses.text: of uncircumcised people you will perish by foreigners’ hands, for I have spoken, says the Lord.”
verses.display_text: of uncircumcised people you will perish by foreigners’ hands, for I have spoken, says the Lord.”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, take up a lament over the ruler of Tyre and say to him: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: You were a seal of likeness and a crown of beauty;
verses.display_text: “Son of man, take up a lament over the ruler of Tyre and say to him: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: You were a seal of likeness and a crown of beauty;

verses.text: you came to be in the delight of God’s paradise. You have been clothed with every good stone: carnelian, topaz, emerald, carbuncle, sapphire, jasper, silver, gold, ligurite, agate, amethyst, chrysolite, beryl, and onyx. You filled your treasuries and storehouses within you with gold from the day you were created.
verses.display_text: you came to be in the delight of God’s paradise. You have been clothed with every good stone: carnelian, topaz, emerald, carbuncle, sapphire, jasper, silver, gold, ligurite, agate, amethyst, chrysolite, beryl, and onyx. You filled your treasuries and storehouses within you with gold from the day you were created.

verses.text: With the cherub I placed you on God’s holy mountain; you came to be among fiery stones.
verses.display_text: With the cherub I placed you on God’s holy mountain; you came to be among fiery stones.

verses.text: You were blameless in your days from the day you were created until wrongdoings were found in you.
verses.display_text: You were blameless in your days from the day you were created until wrongdoings were found in you.

verses.text: From the abundance of your trade you filled your store chambers with lawlessness, and you sinned and were wounded away from God’s mountain; the cherub led you out from among fiery stones.
verses.display_text: From the abundance of your trade you filled your store chambers with lawlessness, and you sinned and were wounded away from God’s mountain; the cherub led you out from among fiery stones.

verses.text: Your heart was exalted because of your beauty; your knowledge was corrupted together with your beauty. Because of your many sins I threw you to the ground; I placed you before kings to be made a spectacle.
verses.display_text: Your heart was exalted because of your beauty; your knowledge was corrupted together with your beauty. Because of your many sins I threw you to the ground; I placed you before kings to be made a spectacle.

verses.text: Because of your many sins and the wrongdoings of your trade you profaned your sacred places. I will bring fire out from within you; it will consume you. I will turn you to ashes on your land before all who see you.
verses.display_text: Because of your many sins and the wrongdoings of your trade you profaned your sacred places. I will bring fire out from within you; it will consume you. I will turn you to ashes on your land before all who see you.

verses.text: All who know you among the nations will become gloomy over you; you came to ruin, and you will no longer exist for ever.”
verses.display_text: All who know you among the nations will become gloomy over you; you came to ruin, and you will no longer exist for ever.”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, fix your face upon Sidon and prophesy against her,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, fix your face upon Sidon and prophesy against her,

verses.text: and say: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in you. You will know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in you, and I will be sanctified in you.
verses.display_text: and say: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in you. You will know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in you, and I will be sanctified in you.

verses.text: Blood and death will be in your broad streets, and wounded men will fall by swords in you, all around you. They will know that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: Blood and death will be in your broad streets, and wounded men will fall by swords in you, all around you. They will know that I am the Lord.

verses.text: The house of Israel will no longer have a thorn of bitterness or a thorn of pain from all around them who dishonored them. They will know that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: The house of Israel will no longer have a thorn of bitterness or a thorn of pain from all around them who dishonored them. They will know that I am the Lord.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: I will gather Israel from the nations where they were scattered, and I will be sanctified in them before the peoples and the nations. They will dwell on their land, which I have given to My servant Jacob,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: I will gather Israel from the nations where they were scattered, and I will be sanctified in them before the peoples and the nations. They will dwell on their land, which I have given to My servant Jacob,

verses.text: and they will dwell on it in hope, build houses, and plant vineyards. They will dwell in hope when I execute judgment on all around them who dishonored them. They will know that I am the Lord their God and the God of their fathers.”
verses.display_text: and they will dwell on it in hope, build houses, and plant vineyards. They will dwell in hope when I execute judgment on all around them who dishonored them. They will know that I am the Lord their God and the God of their fathers.”

verses.text: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, fix your face upon Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, fix your face upon Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt,

verses.text: and say: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, the great dragon seated among his rivers, who says, ‘The rivers are mine, and I made them.’
verses.display_text: and say: Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh, the great dragon seated among his rivers, who says, ‘The rivers are mine, and I made them.’

verses.text: I will put traps in your jaws and fasten the fish of your river to your fins. I will bring you up from the midst of your river, and all the fish of your river,
verses.display_text: I will put traps in your jaws and fasten the fish of your river to your fins. I will bring you up from the midst of your river, and all the fish of your river,

verses.text: and I will cast you down quickly, and all the fish of your river. You will fall on the face of the plain; you will certainly not be gathered or wrapped for burial. I have given you for food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of heaven.
verses.display_text: and I will cast you down quickly, and all the fish of your river. You will fall on the face of the plain; you will certainly not be gathered or wrapped for burial. I have given you for food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of heaven.

verses.text: All who inhabit Egypt will know that I am the Lord, because you became a reed staff for the house of Israel.
verses.display_text: All who inhabit Egypt will know that I am the Lord, because you became a reed staff for the house of Israel.

verses.text: When they took hold of you with their hand, you were crushed; and when every hand prevailed against them, and when they rested upon you, you were shattered and broke all their loins.
verses.display_text: When they took hold of you with their hand, you were crushed; and when every hand prevailed against them, and when they rested upon you, you were shattered and broke all their loins.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing a sword against you, and I will destroy humans and livestock from you.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Behold, I am bringing a sword against you, and I will destroy humans and livestock from you.

verses.text: The land of Egypt will become a ruin and a wilderness, and they will know that I am the Lord, because you say, ‘The rivers are mine, and I made them.’
verses.display_text: The land of Egypt will become a ruin and a wilderness, and they will know that I am the Lord, because you say, ‘The rivers are mine, and I made them.’

verses.text: Therefore, behold, I am against you and against all your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt a wilderness, a sword, and destruction, from Migdol and Syene as far as the borders of the Ethiopians.
verses.display_text: Therefore, behold, I am against you and against all your rivers. I will make the land of Egypt a wilderness, a sword, and destruction, from Migdol and Syene as far as the borders of the Ethiopians.

verses.text: No human foot will pass through it, nor will livestock’s foot pass through it; it will not be inhabited for forty years.
verses.display_text: No human foot will pass through it, nor will livestock’s foot pass through it; it will not be inhabited for forty years.

verses.text: I will make her land a ruin amid desolated land, and her cities will be amid desolated cities for forty years. I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the countries.
verses.display_text: I will make her land a ruin amid desolated land, and her cities will be amid desolated cities for forty years. I will scatter Egypt among the nations and winnow them into the countries.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were scattered,

verses.text: and I will turn back the captivity of the Egyptians and settle them in the land of Pathros, in the land from which they were taken; it will be a lowly dominion
verses.display_text: and I will turn back the captivity of the Egyptians and settle them in the land of Pathros, in the land from which they were taken; it will be a lowly dominion

verses.text: among all the dominions; it will no longer be exalted over the nations, and I will make them few, so that they are not more numerous among the nations.
verses.display_text: among all the dominions; it will no longer be exalted over the nations, and I will make them few, so that they are not more numerous among the nations.

verses.text: They will no longer be a hope for the house of Israel, bringing lawlessness to remembrance when they follow after them. They will know that I am the Lord.”
verses.display_text: They will no longer be a hope for the house of Israel, bringing lawlessness to remembrance when they follow after them. They will know that I am the Lord.”

verses.text: In the twenty-seventh year, on the first of the first month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: In the twenty-seventh year, on the first of the first month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon subjected his force to great servitude against Tyre; every head was bald and every shoulder was losing its hair. Yet neither he nor his force received wages for Tyre and the servitude they performed against her.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon subjected his force to great servitude against Tyre; every head was bald and every shoulder was losing its hair. Yet neither he nor his force received wages for Tyre and the servitude they performed against her.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will take her booty and strip her spoils; it will be wages for his force.
