verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. He will take her booty and strip her spoils; it will be wages for his force.

verses.text: In exchange for his service, which he performed against Tyre, I have given him the land of Egypt. Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.display_text: In exchange for his service, which he performed against Tyre, I have given him the land of Egypt. Thus says the Lord, the Lord:

verses.text: On that day a horn will spring up for the whole house of Israel, and I will give you an opened mouth among them. They will know that I am the Lord.”
verses.display_text: On that day a horn will spring up for the whole house of Israel, and I will give you an opened mouth among them. They will know that I am the Lord.”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, prophesy and say: Thus says the Lord: Alas, alas, the day!
verses.display_text: “Son of man, prophesy and say: Thus says the Lord: Alas, alas, the day!

verses.text: For the Lord’s day is near; it will be a day, an end of nations.
verses.display_text: For the Lord’s day is near; it will be a day, an end of nations.

verses.text: A sword will come upon the Egyptians, and there will be turmoil in Ethiopia; wounded men will fall in Egypt, and her foundations will collapse together.
verses.display_text: A sword will come upon the Egyptians, and there will be turmoil in Ethiopia; wounded men will fall in Egypt, and her foundations will collapse together.

verses.text: Persians, Cretans, Lydians, Libyans, all the mixed company, and some of the sons of My covenant will fall by the sword in her.
verses.display_text: Persians, Cretans, Lydians, Libyans, all the mixed company, and some of the sons of My covenant will fall by the sword in her.

verses.text: Egypt’s supports will fall, and the arrogance of her strength will come down from Migdol to Syene; they will fall in her by the sword, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Egypt’s supports will fall, and the arrogance of her strength will come down from Migdol to Syene; they will fall in her by the sword, says the Lord.

verses.text: She will be desolated among desolated countries, and their cities will be among desolated cities.
verses.display_text: She will be desolated among desolated countries, and their cities will be among desolated cities.

verses.text: They will know that I am the Lord when I put fire upon Egypt and all who help her are shattered.
verses.display_text: They will know that I am the Lord when I put fire upon Egypt and all who help her are shattered.

verses.text: On that day messengers will go out, hastening to lay Ethiopia waste; turmoil will be among them on Egypt’s day, for behold, it is coming.
verses.display_text: On that day messengers will go out, hastening to lay Ethiopia waste; turmoil will be among them on Egypt’s day, for behold, it is coming.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: I will destroy the multitude of Egyptians by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: I will destroy the multitude of Egyptians by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon,

verses.text: him and his people: scourges from nations sent to destroy the land. They will all draw their swords against Egypt, and the land will be filled with wounded men.
verses.display_text: him and his people: scourges from nations sent to destroy the land. They will all draw their swords against Egypt, and the land will be filled with wounded men.

verses.text: I will make their rivers desolate and destroy the land and all that fills it by foreigners’ hands. I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.display_text: I will make their rivers desolate and destroy the land and all that fills it by foreigners’ hands. I, the Lord, have spoken.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: I will destroy the magnates from Memphis and the rulers from the land of Egypt, and they will be no more.
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: I will destroy the magnates from Memphis and the rulers from the land of Egypt, and they will be no more.

verses.text: I will destroy the land of Pathros, put fire upon Tanis, and execute vengeance in Diospolis,
verses.display_text: I will destroy the land of Pathros, put fire upon Tanis, and execute vengeance in Diospolis,

verses.text: and pour out My wrath upon Sais, Egypt’s strength, and destroy the multitude of Memphis.
verses.display_text: and pour out My wrath upon Sais, Egypt’s strength, and destroy the multitude of Memphis.

verses.text: I will put fire upon Egypt; Syene will be greatly troubled, and in Diospolis there will be a breach, and waters will pour out.
verses.display_text: I will put fire upon Egypt; Syene will be greatly troubled, and in Diospolis there will be a breach, and waters will pour out.

verses.text: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the women will go into captivity.
verses.display_text: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the women will go into captivity.

verses.text: At Tahpanhes the day will grow dark when I shatter Egypt’s scepters there and the arrogance of her strength perishes there. A cloud will cover her, and her daughters will be led away captive.
verses.display_text: At Tahpanhes the day will grow dark when I shatter Egypt’s scepters there and the arrogance of her strength perishes there. A cloud will cover her, and her daughters will be led away captive.

verses.text: I will execute judgment in Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord.”
verses.display_text: I will execute judgment in Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord.”

verses.text: In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: In the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, I shattered the arms of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up to provide healing, to put a poultice upon it, to give strength to grasp a sword.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, I shattered the arms of Pharaoh king of Egypt. Behold, it has not been bound up to provide healing, to put a poultice upon it, to give strength to grasp a sword.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will shatter his arms, the strong and the outstretched, and cast his sword down from his hand,
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will shatter his arms, the strong and the outstretched, and cast his sword down from his hand,

verses.text: and scatter Egypt into the nations and winnow them into the countries.
verses.display_text: and scatter Egypt into the nations and winnow them into the countries.

verses.text: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword into his hand; he will bring it upon Egypt, take her booty, and strip her spoils.
verses.display_text: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword into his hand; he will bring it upon Egypt, take her booty, and strip her spoils.

verses.text: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but Pharaoh’s arms will fall. They will know that I am the Lord when I put My sword into the hands of the king of Babylon and he stretches it over the land of Egypt.
verses.display_text: I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but Pharaoh’s arms will fall. They will know that I am the Lord when I put My sword into the hands of the king of Babylon and he stretches it over the land of Egypt.

verses.text: I will scatter Egypt into the nations and winnow them into the countries. All will know that I am the Lord.”
verses.display_text: I will scatter Egypt into the nations and winnow them into the countries. All will know that I am the Lord.”

verses.text: In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: In the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, and to his multitude, ‘To whom did you liken yourself in your height?
verses.display_text: “Son of man, say to Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, and to his multitude, ‘To whom did you liken yourself in your height?

verses.text: Behold, Assyria was a cypress in Lebanon, beautiful in offshoots and tall in size; its crown reached into the midst of clouds.
verses.display_text: Behold, Assyria was a cypress in Lebanon, beautiful in offshoots and tall in size; its crown reached into the midst of clouds.

verses.text: Water nourished it; the abyss raised it high, led its rivers around its plantings and sent out its gatherings of water to all the plain’s trees.
verses.display_text: Water nourished it; the abyss raised it high, led its rivers around its plantings and sent out its gatherings of water to all the plain’s trees.

verses.text: Therefore its size rose above all the plain’s trees, and its branches spread wide because of abundant water.
verses.display_text: Therefore its size rose above all the plain’s trees, and its branches spread wide because of abundant water.

verses.text: All the sky’s birds nested in its offshoots; all the plain’s beasts gave birth beneath its branches, and every multitude of nations lived in its shade.
verses.display_text: All the sky’s birds nested in its offshoots; all the plain’s beasts gave birth beneath its branches, and every multitude of nations lived in its shade.

verses.text: It was beautiful in its height because of the multitude of its branches, for its roots reached abundant water.
verses.display_text: It was beautiful in its height because of the multitude of its branches, for its roots reached abundant water.

verses.text: Such cypresses did not exist in God’s paradise; pines were not like its offshoots, and firs were not like its branches. No tree in God’s paradise resembled it in its beauty
verses.display_text: Such cypresses did not exist in God’s paradise; pines were not like its offshoots, and firs were not like its branches. No tree in God’s paradise resembled it in its beauty

verses.text: because of the multitude of its branches, and the trees of God’s paradise of delight envied it.
verses.display_text: because of the multitude of its branches, and the trees of God’s paradise of delight envied it.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you became great in size and set your crown amid clouds, and I saw it being lifted high,
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you became great in size and set your crown amid clouds, and I saw it being lifted high,

verses.text: I handed it into the hands of a ruler of nations, and he brought about its destruction.
verses.display_text: I handed it into the hands of a ruler of nations, and he brought about its destruction.

verses.text: Foreigners, scourges from nations, utterly destroyed it and cast it upon the mountains. Its branches fell in all the ravines; its trunks were shattered in every plain of the land. All the nations’ peoples went down from their shelter and dashed it to the ground.
verses.display_text: Foreigners, scourges from nations, utterly destroyed it and cast it upon the mountains. Its branches fell in all the ravines; its trunks were shattered in every plain of the land. All the nations’ peoples went down from their shelter and dashed it to the ground.

verses.text: All the sky’s birds rested upon its fallen trunk, and all the field’s beasts were upon its trunks,
verses.display_text: All the sky’s birds rested upon its fallen trunk, and all the field’s beasts were upon its trunks,

verses.text: so that none of the trees in the water may rise high in their size. They did not set their crowns amid clouds, and none of those drinking water stood toward them in their height. All were given to death, to the depth of the earth, among human beings, with those descending to a pit.
verses.display_text: so that none of the trees in the water may rise high in their size. They did not set their crowns amid clouds, and none of those drinking water stood toward them in their height. All were given to death, to the depth of the earth, among human beings, with those descending to a pit.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: On the day it descended to Hades, the abyss mourned it. I stopped its rivers and restrained the multitude of water. Lebanon grew dark over it, and all the plain’s trees collapsed over it.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: On the day it descended to Hades, the abyss mourned it. I stopped its rivers and restrained the multitude of water. Lebanon grew dark over it, and all the plain’s trees collapsed over it.

verses.text: At the sound of its fall the nations shook when I brought it down to Hades with those descending to a pit. In the earth all the trees of delight and the choice trees of Lebanon, all drinking water, comforted it.
verses.display_text: At the sound of its fall the nations shook when I brought it down to Hades with those descending to a pit. In the earth all the trees of delight and the choice trees of Lebanon, all drinking water, comforted it.

verses.text: For they too went down with it to Hades among those wounded by the sword; its offspring, those living under its shelter, perished in the midst of their life.
verses.display_text: For they too went down with it to Hades among those wounded by the sword; its offspring, those living under its shelter, perished in the midst of their life.

verses.text: Whom were you likened to? Descend and be brought down with the trees of delight into the earth’s depth. Among the uncircumcised you will lie with those wounded by the sword. So it is with Pharaoh and the multitude of his strength, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: Whom were you likened to? Descend and be brought down with the trees of delight into the earth’s depth. Among the uncircumcised you will lie with those wounded by the sword. So it is with Pharaoh and the multitude of his strength, says the Lord, the Lord.’”

verses.text: In the eleventh year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: In the eleventh year, in the twelfth month, on the first of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, take up a lament over Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, and say to him, ‘You were likened to a lion of nations, and you are like the dragon in the sea. You butted in your rivers, troubled water with your feet and trampled your rivers.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, take up a lament over Pharaoh, Egypt’s king, and say to him, ‘You were likened to a lion of nations, and you are like the dragon in the sea. You butted in your rivers, troubled water with your feet and trampled your rivers.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: I will throw nets of many peoples over you and haul you up with My hook,
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: I will throw nets of many peoples over you and haul you up with My hook,

verses.text: and stretch you out upon the earth; plains will be filled with you. I will seat all the sky’s birds upon you and fill all the beasts of the whole earth with you.
verses.display_text: and stretch you out upon the earth; plains will be filled with you. I will seat all the sky’s birds upon you and fill all the beasts of the whole earth with you.

verses.text: I will lay your flesh upon the mountains and fill them with your blood,
verses.display_text: I will lay your flesh upon the mountains and fill them with your blood,

verses.text: and the earth will be watered from your discharges, from your multitude upon the mountains. I will fill ravines with you.
verses.display_text: and the earth will be watered from your discharges, from your multitude upon the mountains. I will fill ravines with you.

verses.text: When you are extinguished, I will cover heaven and darken its stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon certainly will not show its light.
verses.display_text: When you are extinguished, I will cover heaven and darken its stars. I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon certainly will not show its light.

verses.text: All the things shining light in heaven will grow dark over you, and I will put darkness upon your land, says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.display_text: All the things shining light in heaven will grow dark over you, and I will put darkness upon your land, says the Lord, the Lord.

verses.text: I will provoke the heart of many peoples when I bring your captivity among the nations, into a land you have not known.
verses.display_text: I will provoke the heart of many peoples when I bring your captivity among the nations, into a land you have not known.

verses.text: Many nations will grow gloomy over you; their kings will be utterly astounded when My sword flies before their faces, awaiting their own fall from the day of your fall.
verses.display_text: Many nations will grow gloomy over you; their kings will be utterly astounded when My sword flies before their faces, awaiting their own fall from the day of your fall.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord: Babylon’s king’s sword will come upon you
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord: Babylon’s king’s sword will come upon you

verses.text: with giants’ swords, and I will strike down your strength. All are scourges from nations; they will destroy Egypt’s arrogance, and all her strength will be shattered.
verses.display_text: with giants’ swords, and I will strike down your strength. All are scourges from nations; they will destroy Egypt’s arrogance, and all her strength will be shattered.

verses.text: I will destroy all her livestock beside the abundant water. No human foot will ever trouble it again, nor will livestock’s tread trample it.
verses.display_text: I will destroy all her livestock beside the abundant water. No human foot will ever trouble it again, nor will livestock’s tread trample it.

verses.text: Thus their waters will then become still, and their rivers will flow like oil, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: Thus their waters will then become still, and their rivers will flow like oil, says the Lord.

verses.text: When I give Egypt to destruction and the land is made desolate with its fullness, when I scatter all who dwell in her, they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: When I give Egypt to destruction and the land is made desolate with its fullness, when I scatter all who dwell in her, they will know that I am the Lord.

verses.text: It is a lament, and you will lament it, and the nations’ daughters will lament it. Over Egypt and all her strength they will lament her, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: It is a lament, and you will lament it, and the nations’ daughters will lament it. Over Egypt and all her strength they will lament her, says the Lord, the Lord.’”

verses.text: In the twelfth year, in the first month, on the fifteenth of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: In the twelfth year, in the first month, on the fifteenth of the month, the Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, lament over Egypt’s strength. The nations will bring her daughters down dead into the earth’s depth, with those descending to a pit.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, lament over Egypt’s strength. The nations will bring her daughters down dead into the earth’s depth, with those descending to a pit.

verses.text: They will fall with him among those wounded by the sword, and all his strength will lie down.
verses.display_text: They will fall with him among those wounded by the sword, and all his strength will lie down.

verses.text: The giants will say to you, ‘Be in the depth of a pit! Whom do you surpass? Descend and lie with the uncircumcised among those wounded by the sword.’
verses.display_text: The giants will say to you, ‘Be in the depth of a pit! Whom do you surpass? Descend and lie with the uncircumcised among those wounded by the sword.’

verses.text: There Assyria and all his assembly, all wounded, were placed. Their burial is in the depth of a pit, and his assembly was around his tomb, all the wounded who fell by the sword,
verses.display_text: There Assyria and all his assembly, all wounded, were placed. Their burial is in the depth of a pit, and his assembly was around his tomb, all the wounded who fell by the sword,

verses.text: who spread their fear upon the land of life.
verses.display_text: who spread their fear upon the land of life.

verses.text: There is Elam and all his force around his tomb, all the wounded who fell by the sword and those descending uncircumcised into the earth’s depth, who spread their fear upon the land of life and received their torment with those descending to a pit,
verses.display_text: There is Elam and all his force around his tomb, all the wounded who fell by the sword and those descending uncircumcised into the earth’s depth, who spread their fear upon the land of life and received their torment with those descending to a pit,

verses.text: among the wounded.
verses.display_text: among the wounded.

verses.text: There were placed Mosoch and Thobel and all their strength around his tomb, all his wounded, all uncircumcised, wounded by the sword, who spread their fear upon the land of life.
verses.display_text: There were placed Mosoch and Thobel and all their strength around his tomb, all his wounded, all uncircumcised, wounded by the sword, who spread their fear upon the land of life.

verses.text: They lay with the giants who fell long ago, who descended to Hades with weapons of war and put their swords beneath their heads. Their lawless deeds were upon their bones, because they terrified giants in the land of life.
verses.display_text: They lay with the giants who fell long ago, who descended to Hades with weapons of war and put their swords beneath their heads. Their lawless deeds were upon their bones, because they terrified giants in the land of life.

verses.text: You too will lie among the uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword.
verses.display_text: You too will lie among the uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword.

verses.text: There were placed Assyria’s rulers, who gave his strength to a sword wound. These lay with the wounded, with those descending to a pit.
verses.display_text: There were placed Assyria’s rulers, who gave his strength to a sword wound. These lay with the wounded, with those descending to a pit.

verses.text: There are the north’s rulers, all Assyria’s generals, who descended wounded. With their fear and their strength they lay uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword and carried away their torment with those descending to a pit.
verses.display_text: There are the north’s rulers, all Assyria’s generals, who descended wounded. With their fear and their strength they lay uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword and carried away their torment with those descending to a pit.

verses.text: King Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all their strength, says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.display_text: King Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all their strength, says the Lord, the Lord.

verses.text: For I have set his fear upon the land of life, and he will lie among the uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword—Pharaoh and all his multitude—says the Lord, the Lord.”
verses.display_text: For I have set his fear upon the land of life, and he will lie among the uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword—Pharaoh and all his multitude—says the Lord, the Lord.”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, speak to your people’s sons and say to them, ‘If I bring a sword upon a land, and the land’s people take one man from among themselves and appoint him as their watchman,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, speak to your people’s sons and say to them, ‘If I bring a sword upon a land, and the land’s people take one man from among themselves and appoint him as their watchman,

verses.text: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, sounds the trumpet and signals to the people,
verses.display_text: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, sounds the trumpet and signals to the people,

verses.text: and a hearer hears the trumpet’s sound but does not take care, and the sword comes upon him and overtakes him, his blood will be upon his own head.
verses.display_text: and a hearer hears the trumpet’s sound but does not take care, and the sword comes upon him and overtakes him, his blood will be upon his own head.

verses.text: Because he heard the trumpet’s sound and did not take care, his blood will be upon himself. But this one, because he took care, rescued his life.
verses.display_text: Because he heard the trumpet’s sound and did not take care, his blood will be upon himself. But this one, because he took care, rescued his life.

verses.text: If the watchman sees the sword coming but does not signal with the trumpet, and the people do not take care, and the sword comes and takes a life from them, that life was taken because of its own lawlessness, but I will require the blood from the watchman’s hand.’
verses.display_text: If the watchman sees the sword coming but does not signal with the trumpet, and the people do not take care, and the sword comes and takes a life from them, that life was taken because of its own lawlessness, but I will require the blood from the watchman’s hand.’

verses.text: And you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for Israel’s house, and you will hear a word from My mouth.
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for Israel’s house, and you will hear a word from My mouth.

verses.text: When I say to the sinner, ‘You will surely be put to death,’ and you do not speak so that the impious man may guard himself from his way, that lawless man will die in his lawlessness, but I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.display_text: When I say to the sinner, ‘You will surely be put to death,’ and you do not speak so that the impious man may guard himself from his way, that lawless man will die in his lawlessness, but I will require his blood from your hand.

verses.text: But if you forewarn the impious man of his way so that he may turn from it and he does not turn from his way, this man will die in his impiety, and you have rescued your own life.
verses.display_text: But if you forewarn the impious man of his way so that he may turn from it and he does not turn from his way, this man will die in his impiety, and you have rescued your own life.

verses.text: And you, son of man, say to Israel’s house, ‘You spoke this way: Our wanderings and lawless deeds are upon us, and we waste away in them. How shall we live?’
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, say to Israel’s house, ‘You spoke this way: Our wanderings and lawless deeds are upon us, and we waste away in them. How shall we live?’

verses.text: Say to them, ‘I live, thus says the Lord: I do not desire the impious man’s death, but rather that he turn from his way and live. Turn back completely from your way! Why are you dying, house of Israel?’
verses.display_text: Say to them, ‘I live, thus says the Lord: I do not desire the impious man’s death, but rather that he turn from his way and live. Turn back completely from your way! Why are you dying, house of Israel?’

verses.text: Say to your people’s sons, ‘A righteous man’s righteousness certainly will not rescue him on the day he wanders, and an impious man’s lawlessness certainly will not harm him on the day he turns from it. A righteous man certainly will not be able to be saved.
verses.display_text: Say to your people’s sons, ‘A righteous man’s righteousness certainly will not rescue him on the day he wanders, and an impious man’s lawlessness certainly will not harm him on the day he turns from it. A righteous man certainly will not be able to be saved.

verses.text: When I speak to the righteous man—this one has trusted in his righteousness, yet commits lawlessness—none of his righteous deeds will ever be remembered. In the injustice he committed, in it he will die.
verses.display_text: When I speak to the righteous man—this one has trusted in his righteousness, yet commits lawlessness—none of his righteous deeds will ever be remembered. In the injustice he committed, in it he will die.

verses.text: When I say to the impious man, “You will surely be put to death,” and he turns from his sin and practices judgment and righteousness,
verses.display_text: When I say to the impious man, “You will surely be put to death,” and he turns from his sin and practices judgment and righteousness,

verses.text: and returns a pledge, repays what he seized and walks in the ordinances of life without doing wrong, he will surely live and certainly will not die.
verses.display_text: and returns a pledge, repays what he seized and walks in the ordinances of life without doing wrong, he will surely live and certainly will not die.

verses.text: None of the sins he committed will ever be remembered, because he practiced judgment and righteousness; in these he will live.
verses.display_text: None of the sins he committed will ever be remembered, because he practiced judgment and righteousness; in these he will live.

verses.text: Your people’s sons will say, “The Lord’s way is not straight.” Yet this way of theirs is not straight.
verses.display_text: Your people’s sons will say, “The Lord’s way is not straight.” Yet this way of theirs is not straight.

verses.text: When a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits lawless deeds, he will die in them.
verses.display_text: When a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits lawless deeds, he will die in them.

verses.text: When the sinner turns from his lawlessness and practices judgment and righteousness, in these he will live.
verses.display_text: When the sinner turns from his lawlessness and practices judgment and righteousness, in these he will live.

verses.text: This is what you said: “The Lord’s way is not straight.” I will judge you, each in his ways, house of Israel.’”
verses.display_text: This is what you said: “The Lord’s way is not straight.” I will judge you, each in his ways, house of Israel.’”

verses.text: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the twelfth month, on the fifth of the month, the survivor from Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been captured!”
verses.display_text: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the twelfth month, on the fifth of the month, the survivor from Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been captured!”

verses.text: The Lord’s hand came upon me in the evening before he arrived, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning. Once my mouth was opened, it was no longer restrained.
verses.display_text: The Lord’s hand came upon me in the evening before he arrived, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning. Once my mouth was opened, it was no longer restrained.

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, those dwelling in the devastated places upon Israel’s land say, ‘Abraham was one, yet he possessed the land. We are more; the land has been given to us as a possession.’
verses.display_text: “Son of man, those dwelling in the devastated places upon Israel’s land say, ‘Abraham was one, yet he possessed the land. We are more; the land has been given to us as a possession.’

verses.text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.display_text: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord:

verses.text: I live: surely those in the devastated places will fall by the sword. Those in the open plain will be given as food to the field’s beasts, and those in fortified places and caves I will kill with death.
verses.display_text: I live: surely those in the devastated places will fall by the sword. Those in the open plain will be given as food to the field’s beasts, and those in fortified places and caves I will kill with death.

verses.text: I will make the land a wilderness; the arrogance of her strength will perish, and Israel’s mountains will be desolate because no one passes through.
verses.display_text: I will make the land a wilderness; the arrogance of her strength will perish, and Israel’s mountains will be desolate because no one passes through.

verses.text: They will know that I am the Lord. I will make their land a wilderness, and it will be desolate because of all the abominations they committed.’
verses.display_text: They will know that I am the Lord. I will make their land a wilderness, and it will be desolate because of all the abominations they committed.’

verses.text: And you, son of man, your people’s sons talk about you beside the walls and in the houses’ gateways. A man says to his brother, ‘Let us gather and hear what comes from the Lord!’
verses.display_text: And you, son of man, your people’s sons talk about you beside the walls and in the houses’ gateways. A man says to his brother, ‘Let us gather and hear what comes from the Lord!’

verses.text: They come to you as people assemble and sit before you. They hear your words but certainly will not do them, because falsehood is in their mouth, and their heart follows defilements.
verses.display_text: They come to you as people assemble and sit before you. They hear your words but certainly will not do them, because falsehood is in their mouth, and their heart follows defilements.

verses.text: You become to them like the sound of a sweet-voiced, well-tuned psaltery. They will hear your words but certainly will not do them.
verses.display_text: You become to them like the sound of a sweet-voiced, well-tuned psaltery. They will hear your words but certainly will not do them.

verses.text: When it comes, they will say, ‘Behold, it has arrived,’ and know that a prophet was among them.”
verses.display_text: When it comes, they will say, ‘Behold, it has arrived,’ and know that a prophet was among them.”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s shepherds. Prophesy and say to the shepherds, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: O shepherds of Israel, surely shepherds do not feed themselves? Do shepherds not feed the sheep?
verses.display_text: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s shepherds. Prophesy and say to the shepherds, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: O shepherds of Israel, surely shepherds do not feed themselves? Do shepherds not feed the sheep?

verses.text: Behold, you consume the milk, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the fattened animal, but you do not feed My sheep.
verses.display_text: Behold, you consume the milk, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the fattened animal, but you do not feed My sheep.

verses.text: You have not strengthened the weak, restored the sick to health, bound up the broken, brought back the wandering or sought the lost. You have worn down the strong with toil.
verses.display_text: You have not strengthened the weak, restored the sick to health, bound up the broken, brought back the wandering or sought the lost. You have worn down the strong with toil.

verses.text: My sheep scattered because there were no shepherds and became food for all the field’s beasts.
verses.display_text: My sheep scattered because there were no shepherds and became food for all the field’s beasts.

verses.text: My sheep scattered on every mountain and upon every high hill, and scattered over the whole face of the earth. There was no one seeking them out or turning them back.
verses.display_text: My sheep scattered on every mountain and upon every high hill, and scattered over the whole face of the earth. There was no one seeking them out or turning them back.

verses.text: Therefore, shepherds, hear the Lord’s word:
verses.display_text: Therefore, shepherds, hear the Lord’s word:

verses.text: I live, says the Lord, the Lord: surely because My sheep became plunder and My sheep became food for all the plain’s beasts for lack of shepherds, and the shepherds did not seek out My sheep but fed themselves and did not feed My sheep—
verses.display_text: I live, says the Lord, the Lord: surely because My sheep became plunder and My sheep became food for all the plain’s beasts for lack of shepherds, and the shepherds did not seek out My sheep but fed themselves and did not feed My sheep—

verses.text: because of this, shepherds,
verses.display_text: because of this, shepherds,

verses.text: thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require My sheep from their hands and turn them aside from shepherding My sheep. The shepherds will no longer feed them. I will rescue My sheep from their mouth, and they will no longer be food for them.
verses.display_text: thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require My sheep from their hands and turn them aside from shepherding My sheep. The shepherds will no longer feed them. I will rescue My sheep from their mouth, and they will no longer be food for them.

verses.text: For thus says the Lord: Behold, I will seek out My sheep and visit them.
verses.display_text: For thus says the Lord: Behold, I will seek out My sheep and visit them.

verses.text: As a shepherd seeks his flock on a day when there is gloom and cloud among separated sheep, so I will seek out My sheep and drive them away from every place where they scattered on a day of cloud and gloom.
verses.display_text: As a shepherd seeks his flock on a day when there is gloom and cloud among separated sheep, so I will seek out My sheep and drive them away from every place where they scattered on a day of cloud and gloom.

verses.text: I will bring them out from the nations, gather them from the countries and bring them into their own land. I will feed them upon Israel’s mountains, in the ravines and in every dwelling place of the land.
verses.display_text: I will bring them out from the nations, gather them from the countries and bring them into their own land. I will feed them upon Israel’s mountains, in the ravines and in every dwelling place of the land.

verses.text: I will feed them in good pasture, and their folds will be upon Israel’s high mountain. There they will lie down, there rest in good delight, and graze in rich pasture upon Israel’s mountains.
verses.display_text: I will feed them in good pasture, and their folds will be upon Israel’s high mountain. There they will lie down, there rest in good delight, and graze in rich pasture upon Israel’s mountains.

verses.text: I Myself will feed My sheep and give them rest, and they will know that I am the Lord. Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.display_text: I Myself will feed My sheep and give them rest, and they will know that I am the Lord. Thus says the Lord, the Lord:

verses.text: I will seek the lost, bring back the wandering, bind up the broken, strengthen the failing and guard the strong. I will feed them with judgment.
verses.display_text: I will seek the lost, bring back the wandering, bind up the broken, strengthen the failing and guard the strong. I will feed them with judgment.

verses.text: And you, sheep, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I will distinguish between sheep and sheep, rams and male goats.
verses.display_text: And you, sheep, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I will distinguish between sheep and sheep, rams and male goats.

verses.text: Was it not enough for you that you grazed the good pasture, yet trampled the rest of your pasture with your feet, drank the settled water and troubled the rest with your feet?
verses.display_text: Was it not enough for you that you grazed the good pasture, yet trampled the rest of your pasture with your feet, drank the settled water and troubled the rest with your feet?

verses.text: My sheep grazed what your feet had trampled and drank the water troubled by your feet.
verses.display_text: My sheep grazed what your feet had trampled and drank the water troubled by your feet.

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I will distinguish between the strong sheep and the weak sheep.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I will distinguish between the strong sheep and the weak sheep.

verses.text: You shove with your sides and shoulders; you butted with your horns and forced out every failing one.
verses.display_text: You shove with your sides and shoulders; you butted with your horns and forced out every failing one.

verses.text: I will save My sheep, and they certainly will no longer be plunder. I will judge between ram and ram.
verses.display_text: I will save My sheep, and they certainly will no longer be plunder. I will judge between ram and ram.

verses.text: I will raise up one shepherd over them, My servant David, and he will shepherd them and be their shepherd.
verses.display_text: I will raise up one shepherd over them, My servant David, and he will shepherd them and be their shepherd.

verses.text: I, the Lord, will be their God, and David a ruler among them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.display_text: I, the Lord, will be their God, and David a ruler among them. I, the Lord, have spoken.

verses.text: I will make a covenant of peace with David and remove harmful beasts from the land. They will dwell in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
verses.display_text: I will make a covenant of peace with David and remove harmful beasts from the land. They will dwell in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.

verses.text: I will place them around My mountain and give you rain, rain of blessing.
verses.display_text: I will place them around My mountain and give you rain, rain of blessing.

verses.text: The trees in the plain will give their fruit, and the land will give its strength. They will dwell upon their land in hope of peace and know that I am the Lord when I shatter their yoke. I will rescue them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
verses.display_text: The trees in the plain will give their fruit, and the land will give its strength. They will dwell upon their land in hope of peace and know that I am the Lord when I shatter their yoke. I will rescue them from the hand of those who enslaved them.

verses.text: They will no longer be plunder for the nations, and the land’s beasts certainly will no longer eat them. They will dwell in hope, and no one will terrify them.
verses.display_text: They will no longer be plunder for the nations, and the land’s beasts certainly will no longer eat them. They will dwell in hope, and no one will terrify them.

verses.text: I will raise up a plant of peace for them. They will no longer perish by famine upon the land or bear the nations’ reproach.
verses.display_text: I will raise up a plant of peace for them. They will no longer perish by famine upon the land or bear the nations’ reproach.

verses.text: They will know that I am the Lord their God, and they, Israel’s house, are My people, says the Lord.
verses.display_text: They will know that I am the Lord their God, and they, Israel’s house, are My people, says the Lord.

verses.text: You are My sheep and the sheep of My flock, and I am the Lord your God, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: You are My sheep and the sheep of My flock, and I am the Lord your God, says the Lord, the Lord.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
verses.display_text: “Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it,

verses.text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir. I will stretch My hand against you and make you a wilderness, and you will be laid waste.
verses.display_text: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir. I will stretch My hand against you and make you a wilderness, and you will be laid waste.

verses.text: I will make your cities desolate, and you will be a wilderness. You will know that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will make your cities desolate, and you will be a wilderness. You will know that I am the Lord.

verses.text: Because you became an everlasting enemy and ambushed Israel’s house treacherously, by enemies’ hand, with a sword at the final time of injustice,
verses.display_text: Because you became an everlasting enemy and ambushed Israel’s house treacherously, by enemies’ hand, with a sword at the final time of injustice,

verses.text: therefore, I live, says the Lord, the Lord: surely you sinned unto blood, and blood will pursue you.
verses.display_text: therefore, I live, says the Lord, the Lord: surely you sinned unto blood, and blood will pursue you.

verses.text: I will make Mount Seir a wilderness and lay it waste, and destroy human beings and livestock from it,
verses.display_text: I will make Mount Seir a wilderness and lay it waste, and destroy human beings and livestock from it,

verses.text: and fill the hills and your ravines with your wounded. In all your plains, those wounded by the sword will fall within you.
verses.display_text: and fill the hills and your ravines with your wounded. In all your plains, those wounded by the sword will fall within you.

verses.text: I will make you an everlasting wilderness, and your cities certainly will not be inhabited again. You will know that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will make you an everlasting wilderness, and your cities certainly will not be inhabited again. You will know that I am the Lord.

verses.text: Because you said, “The two nations and the two countries will be mine, and I will inherit them,” and the Lord is there,
verses.display_text: Because you said, “The two nations and the two countries will be mine, and I will inherit them,” and the Lord is there,

verses.text: therefore, I live, says the Lord: I will deal with you according to your hostility and make Myself known to you when I judge you.
verses.display_text: therefore, I live, says the Lord: I will deal with you according to your hostility and make Myself known to you when I judge you.

verses.text: You will know that I am the Lord. I heard the voice of your blasphemies, because you said, “Israel’s mountains are desolate; they have been given to us for food.”
verses.display_text: You will know that I am the Lord. I heard the voice of your blasphemies, because you said, “Israel’s mountains are desolate; they have been given to us for food.”

verses.text: You spoke grandly against Me with your mouth. I heard.
verses.display_text: You spoke grandly against Me with your mouth. I heard.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: In the rejoicing of the whole earth, I will make you a wilderness.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: In the rejoicing of the whole earth, I will make you a wilderness.

verses.text: You will be a wilderness, Mount Seir, and all Idumea will be utterly consumed. You will know that I am the Lord their God.’”
verses.display_text: You will be a wilderness, Mount Seir, and all Idumea will be utterly consumed. You will know that I am the Lord their God.’”

verses.text: “And you, son of man, prophesy concerning Israel’s mountains and say to Israel’s mountains, ‘Hear the Lord’s word:
verses.display_text: “And you, son of man, prophesy concerning Israel’s mountains and say to Israel’s mountains, ‘Hear the Lord’s word:

verses.text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because the enemy said over you, “Well done! Everlasting wildernesses have become our possession,”
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because the enemy said over you, “Well done! Everlasting wildernesses have become our possession,”

verses.text: therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you became a possession for the remaining nations, and you became a topic on people’s tongues and a reproach to nations,
verses.display_text: therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you became a possession for the remaining nations, and you became a topic on people’s tongues and a reproach to nations,

verses.text: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord to the mountains, hills, ravines, torrents, devastated and destroyed places, and abandoned cities, which became plunder and a trampling place for the remaining nations all around:
verses.display_text: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord to the mountains, hills, ravines, torrents, devastated and destroyed places, and abandoned cities, which became plunder and a trampling place for the remaining nations all around:

verses.text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Surely in the fire of My wrath I have spoken against the remaining nations and all Idumea, because they gave My land to themselves as a possession with rejoicing, dishonoring lives so as to destroy through plunder.
verses.display_text: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Surely in the fire of My wrath I have spoken against the remaining nations and all Idumea, because they gave My land to themselves as a possession with rejoicing, dishonoring lives so as to destroy through plunder.

verses.text: Therefore prophesy over Israel’s land and say to the mountains, hills, ravines and valleys, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and My wrath because you bore the nations’ reproaches.
verses.display_text: Therefore prophesy over Israel’s land and say to the mountains, hills, ravines and valleys, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and My wrath because you bore the nations’ reproaches.

verses.text: Therefore I will raise My hand against the nations around you; these will receive their own dishonor.
verses.display_text: Therefore I will raise My hand against the nations around you; these will receive their own dishonor.

verses.text: But your grapes and fruit, mountains of Israel, My people will consume, for they are drawing near.
verses.display_text: But your grapes and fruit, mountains of Israel, My people will consume, for they are drawing near.

verses.text: For behold, I am toward you; I will look upon you, and you will be cultivated and sown.
verses.display_text: For behold, I am toward you; I will look upon you, and you will be cultivated and sown.

verses.text: I will multiply people upon you, all Israel’s house completely. The cities will be inhabited and the devastated land rebuilt.
verses.display_text: I will multiply people upon you, all Israel’s house completely. The cities will be inhabited and the devastated land rebuilt.

verses.text: I will multiply humans and livestock upon you, settle you as at your beginning and do you good as in your former times. You will know that I am the Lord.
verses.display_text: I will multiply humans and livestock upon you, settle you as at your beginning and do you good as in your former times. You will know that I am the Lord.

verses.text: I will cause people, My people Israel, to be born upon you. They will inherit you, and you will be their possession. You certainly will no longer be bereaved of them.
verses.display_text: I will cause people, My people Israel, to be born upon you. They will inherit you, and you will be their possession. You certainly will no longer be bereaved of them.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because they said to you, “You devour human beings and became bereaved by your nation,”
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because they said to you, “You devour human beings and became bereaved by your nation,”

verses.text: therefore you will no longer eat human beings or bereave your nation, says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.display_text: therefore you will no longer eat human beings or bereave your nation, says the Lord, the Lord.

verses.text: The nations’ dishonor will no longer be heard against you, and you certainly will not bear the peoples’ reproaches, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
verses.display_text: The nations’ dishonor will no longer be heard against you, and you certainly will not bear the peoples’ reproaches, says the Lord, the Lord.’”

verses.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
verses.display_text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,

verses.text: “Son of man, Israel’s house lived upon their land and defiled it by their way, their idols and their uncleannesses. Their way before Me became like the uncleanness of a woman sitting apart.
verses.display_text: “Son of man, Israel’s house lived upon their land and defiled it by their way, their idols and their uncleannesses. Their way before Me became like the uncleanness of a woman sitting apart.

verses.text: I poured My wrath upon them
verses.display_text: I poured My wrath upon them

verses.text: and scattered them among the nations and winnowed them into the countries. I judged them according to their way and their sin.
verses.display_text: and scattered them among the nations and winnowed them into the countries. I judged them according to their way and their sin.

verses.text: They entered the nations where they entered, and profaned My holy name when it was said of them, ‘These are the Lord’s people, and they have left His land.’
verses.display_text: They entered the nations where they entered, and profaned My holy name when it was said of them, ‘These are the Lord’s people, and they have left His land.’

verses.text: I spared them because of My holy name, which Israel’s house profaned among the nations where they entered.
verses.display_text: I spared them because of My holy name, which Israel’s house profaned among the nations where they entered.

verses.text: Therefore say to Israel’s house, ‘Thus says the Lord: I am not acting for you, house of Israel, but because of My holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you entered.
verses.display_text: Therefore say to Israel’s house, ‘Thus says the Lord: I am not acting for you, house of Israel, but because of My holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you entered.

verses.text: I will sanctify My great name, profaned among the nations, which you profaned among them. The nations will know that I am the Lord when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.display_text: I will sanctify My great name, profaned among the nations, which you profaned among them. The nations will know that I am the Lord when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.

verses.text: I will take you out of the nations, gather you out of all the lands and bring you into your own land.
verses.display_text: I will take you out of the nations, gather you out of all the lands and bring you into your own land.

verses.text: I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and all your idols. I will cleanse you.
verses.display_text: I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and all your idols. I will cleanse you.

verses.text: And I will give you a new heart, and I will give a new spirit within you; and I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh, and give you a heart of flesh.
verses.display_text: And I will give you a new heart, and I will give a new spirit within you; and I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh, and give you a heart of flesh.

verses.text: I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My ordinances, keep My judgments and do them.
verses.display_text: I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My ordinances, keep My judgments and do them.

verses.text: You will dwell upon the land I gave your fathers. You will be My people, and I will be your God.
verses.display_text: You will dwell upon the land I gave your fathers. You will be My people, and I will be your God.

verses.text: I will save you from all your uncleannesses, summon the grain and multiply it, and will not bring famine upon you.
verses.display_text: I will save you from all your uncleannesses, summon the grain and multiply it, and will not bring famine upon you.

verses.text: I will multiply the tree’s fruit and the field’s produce, so that you do not bear the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.display_text: I will multiply the tree’s fruit and the field’s produce, so that you do not bear the reproach of famine among the nations.

verses.text: You will remember your evil ways and practices that were not good, and feel disgust before them at your lawless deeds and abominations.
verses.display_text: You will remember your evil ways and practices that were not good, and feel disgust before them at your lawless deeds and abominations.

verses.text: I am not acting because of you, says the Lord, the Lord; this will be known to you. Be ashamed and abashed because of your ways, house of Israel.
verses.display_text: I am not acting because of you, says the Lord, the Lord; this will be known to you. Be ashamed and abashed because of your ways, house of Israel.

verses.text: Thus says the Lord: On the day I cleanse you from all your lawless deeds, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the wilderness places will be rebuilt.
verses.display_text: Thus says the Lord: On the day I cleanse you from all your lawless deeds, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the wilderness places will be rebuilt.

verses.text: The devastated land will be worked, instead of lying devastated before every passerby’s eyes.
verses.display_text: The devastated land will be worked, instead of lying devastated before every passerby’s eyes.

verses.text: They will say, “That devastated land has become like a garden of delight, and the deserted, devastated, razed cities stand fortified.”
